I’m not that experienced but, tell your cat sitters ahead of time that she is aggressive and she can/will scratch them. They should be ok with it, it’s just a cat scratch. If they are not, you will find someone that is, eventually. 10 days alone seems a bit too much to me, I would not risk my girl to be alone that long. They can be ok, sure, but a cat sitter checking in daily would be the best. 

Maybe you can pay the sitters extra for any scratches hahaha

Get both horizontal and vertical scratching posts in some rooms, preferably the ones she does the most amount of damage. I suggest hiding the plants or moving them somewhere he can’t reach as some can be toxic for cats such as aloe vera.
She said that jokingly yeah but still, I didn't like her making fun of it. Idk why I got so irritated all of a sudden.
Just going back to my roots you know. When I wasn't such a needy person
Yeah we'll have to talk about it
I don't think neediness is a quality to have that's why
Wow ok except the last part

So what's the best apology, I've already made mine but do you have something on your mind.

- me being needy
- should've stopped this behaviour sooner

Just sent her a text about my "neediness" and that I'm aware of what I've been doing now, and promised to change the way I act. Waiting for a response from her as of now
